objective: Implement governed Pexels, Pixabay and Pexafy candidate-asset acquisition behind the existing visual provider framework.

rulesConsidered: Visual providers are candidate acquisition resources, not truth authorities.
Provider output does not grant F06 worker authority.
CAS and F07 remain independent artifact truth boundaries.
License, attribution and materialization constraints must survive normalization.

notes: API keys are read only from server-side environment variables.
No arbitrary user-controlled provider base URL was introduced.

changes: Implemented Pixabay image search normalization with download-to-server usage policy.
Implemented Pexafy semantic image search normalization.
Extended CandidateAsset with Pexafy source and usagePolicy metadata.
Added deterministic provider-shaped tests and malformed/credential fail-closed coverage.
Added .okf provider attribution and materialization rules.
verificationPlan: Require repository CI and Team Change Gate before merge.
Run live Pexels/Pixabay/Pexafy proofs only with configured credentials.
Do not mark QUALIFIED based on HTTP 200 or mocked tests.
notes: Implementation status is separate from provider qualification.
Pexels API key issuance is currently paused according to current provider documentation; no live qualification depends on obtaining a new key.
Pixabay materialization policy is explicitly represented so the downstream asset store can enforce download-to-server behavior.
